cacCategories.name: Business Name / Sole Proprietorship (or Partnership)
cacCategories.whoItIsFor: Small businesses, soloentrepreneurs, artisans, retail stores, and service consultants looking for quick legal recognition and a dedicated corporate bank account.
keyFeatures: Simplest and most affordable CAC entity
Permits legal trading and opening a corporate bank account in Nigeria
Can be upgraded toa Limited Liability Company (LLC) as your enterprise expands
requiredFromClient: Two(2) proposed business names (e.g. Choice 1 and Alternative Choice)
Precise nature / specific category of business activities
Full business address (state, LGA, street name, building number)
Proprietor(s) full legal name, date of birth, phone number, and active email
Proprietor(s) residential address
one valid government-issued ID (NIN Slip / Card, International Passport, Driver's License, or Voter's Card)
Clear digital passport photograph
Clear signature specimen on clean white paper
handledByCoachHyela: Pre-screening names for CAC restrictions or prohibited words
official Name Availability Search & Reservation on CAC CRP portal
Accurate classification of business objectives according tostandard CAC codes
Completing electronic Form CAC-BN01
Document formatting and portal upload compliance
Monitoring status, resolving query notes, and delivering the official electronic Certificate & Certified Extract (Status Report)
cacCategories.feesNote: official CAC statutory reservation and filing fees + optional Coach Hyela professional filing assistance. Statutory fees are remitted directly toRemita / CAC.

cacCategories.name: Private Limited Liability Company (LTD)
cacCategories.whoItIsFor: Companies seeking limited liability protection, corporate contracts, multi-shareholder structures, tech startups, and firms bidding for formal tenders or grants.
keyFeatures: Separate legal entity from directors and shareholders
Share capital structure (Minimum 100,000 to1,000,000+ shares depending on industry)
Strongest credibility with banks, enterprise partners, and investors
requiredFromClient: Two(2) proposed company names ending with 'Limited' or 'Ltd'
Authorized share capital amount and how shares are divided among shareholders
Registered office physical address in Nigeria
Particulars of minimum 1 Director and Shareholders (full name, residential address, DoB, phone, email)
Valid government ID (NIN, Passport, Driver's License) for each director & shareholder
Clear passport photographs and signature specimens
Particulars of Company Secretary (optional for small private companies under CAMA)
handledByCoachHyela: official Company Name Availability Search & Reservation
Drafting/adoption of standard Memorandum and Articles of Association (MEMART)
Proper allotment of shares and drafting Statement of Issued Share Capital
Filing Notice of Situation of Registered office
Document formatting, FIRS stamp duty coordination, and CRP electronic submission
Tracking approval, downloading digital Certificate of Incorporation and formal Status Report
cacCategories.feesNote: Includes official CAC name reservation fee, statutory incorporation filing fee, and Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS) stamp duty depending on share capital, plus Coach Hyela handling fee.

cacCategories.name: Incorporated Trustees (NGos, Foundations, Clubs, Associations)
cacCategories.whoItIsFor: Non-profit organizations, charity foundations, community associations, alumni bodies, faith-based ministries, and advocacy initiatives.
keyFeatures: Non-profit corporate status with perpetual succession
Ability tohold land and enter contracts on behalf of the trust
Required for international donor grants and formal NGobank accounts
requiredFromClient: Proposed name (typically starting with or containing 'Incorporated Trustees of...')
Comprehensive Aims and objectives of the body
Particulars of minimum two(2) Trustees (full names, addresses, occupations, phone, email)
Valid government IDs, passport photos, and signature specimens of all trustees
Signed Minutes of the meeting where trustees were formally appointed
Adopted Constitution of the Association
handledByCoachHyela: Name availability reservation with CAC Incorporated Trustees registry
Reviewing the Constitution and Aims/objectives for CAMA compliance
Preparing the Trustee Declaration Forms / Affidavits
Arranging required statutory Newspaper Publications in national dailies
Final portal dossier submission, managing registry reviews, and securing the Certificate of Incorporation
cacCategories.feesNote: CAC name reservation, statutory filing fees, mandatory newspaper publication costs, and Coach Hyela professional dossier assembly fee.

cacCategories.name: Post-Incorporation Compliance & Changes
cacCategories.whoItIsFor: Alreadyregistered businesses or companies needing updates, annual filings, or regulatory status maintenance.
keyFeatures: Keeps entity in good standing (Active status on CAC public search)
Required for banking revalidation and regulatory clearance
requiredFromClient: Existing CAC Registration Number (RC / BN / IT Number)
Current Status Report or Certificate
Specific change required (e.g., Annual Returns, Director change, Address update, Share increase)
Board resolution or proprietor authorization letter
handledByCoachHyela: Entity audit on the CAC CRP database
Drafting required board resolutions and change schedules
Filing statutory Annual Returns tomaintain Active status
Filing changes in directors, proprietors, or registered address
Retrieving updated certified Status Reports
cacCategories.feesNote: Statutory CAC filing charges and any accumulated late-filing penalties set by CAC + Coach Hyela filing fee.
